text.p: Webster Financial Corp said Friday it signed a definitive agreement to buy People's Savings Financial Corp on a stock-for-stock basis in a tax-free exchange.
The merger has a total value of $67.5 million, Webster said.
Webster said it expects to recognize acquisition-related charges of about $5 million after taxes at the time of the transaction.
People's shareholders will receive the equivalent of $34 in Webster common stock for each of their shares, Webster said.
The exchange ratio will be determined by dividing $34 by the average closing price of Webster common stock for a specified 15-day trading period, Webster said.
If the average closing price of Webster common stock is above $40 or falls between $32 and $34 for the trading period, the exchange ratio will be fixed at 0.85 or 1.00, respectively, Webster said.
If the average closing price is below $32, People's has the right to terminate the transaction unless Webster increases the exchange ratio to 1.0625, Webster said.
The purchase price is about 1.4 times People's book value and 16.8 times People's 1996 earnings, Webster said.

The acquisition, which is expected to close in the third quarter of 1997 and to be accounted for as a pooling of interests, is expected to be modestly accretive to Webster's earnings per share in the first year, Webster said.
